# smolpng repository automation

## Meaning

This is smolpng’s repository-owned Forgehand configuration and canonical label mapping. The caller is pinned to Forgehand v0.2.4 (`5bdbacfa6009589cbaeb699c0cfbacacc1b84dff`). It is prepared and locally validated; `FORGEHAND_ENABLED=false` keeps live mechanical effects disabled until the App credential and exact-repository installation route are qualified.

## Policy and writers

[The label policy](../label-policy.json) owns the shared type/Needs vocabulary, six product areas and proposed mechanical ownership. Maintainers apply semantic types and Needs labels through the ordinary authored account. Automatic areas, lifecycle controls, size labels and replies are not live while activation is disabled. No manual result is presented as evidence that those writers ran.

The product profile selects 90 days without non-bot replies plus 7 days after a delivered warning, a separate 14+7-day necessary-response request, and deliberate `still relevant` reopening. No hard metadata gate or automatic merge is selected. The one durable line is `main`; there is no `next` branch. The complete message files preserve these consequences.

Compression includes workflow/PNG/JPEG/toolchain source and the image corpus, not every CLI edit. Desktop includes native integration and shell menus; CLI interaction belongs to User Interface. Build includes CI, packaging and corpus generation tooling, while a routine source file does not make Build true. Documentation includes the corpus guide and license map; photographic binaries remain authored fixture material rather than generated size exclusions. Dependency recognition includes `go.sum` even though review sizing excludes that resolved checksum file. Original upstream license texts are excluded from sizing; authored notice integration stays counted.

## Activation and recovery

Use the [pinned Forgehand maintenance guide](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/forgehand/blob/5bdbacfa6009589cbaeb699c0cfbacacc1b84dff/docs/maintenance.md) for the existing mediated App credential route, exact repository permissions, named-object dry-run, event qualification and enablement. Do not copy raw keys into chat or substitute a personal write token. The current session could not qualify the App route; ordinary GitHub user authentication is not an App JWT.

Forgehand does not measure sizes. A diffdevil packet was prepared separately but is not installed or activated in this repository. Qualify its managed-App route or the selected repository Action bridge before adding its caller/configuration, with exactly one size writer.

To stop this caller, keep or set `FORGEHAND_ENABLED=false`; that does not change `main` protection or ordinary Verify CI. Re-enable only after a fresh named-object plan and provider readback.
